title: Nd:Yttrium Aluminum Garnet Laser Treatment for Lichen Sclerosus
brief_summary: This study evaluates the efficacy of Nd:Yttrium Aluminum Garnet Laser (Nd:YAG) Treatment of Lichen sclerosus in comparison with topical corticosteroid treatment. Half of participants will receive laser treatment and the other half corticosteroid treatment and the results will be followed for 6 months.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* histologically confirmed Lichen sclerosus
* voluntary signed informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* pregnancy
* use of photosensitizing medication
* pathology other than Lichen
* damage of tissues in the treatment area
* other inflammation
* refusal to sign informed consent
